general.notes: Title and primary ordering part LS-MM858G-S3C: operating case 0°C to +70°C. LS-MM858G-S3I ordering variant: -40°C to +85°C. Recommended operating also lists Extended case -20°C to +85°C. Receiver sensitivity, overload, and LOS levels per Note 3: PRBS 2^31-1 @ 10312Mbps, BER ≤1×10^-12. Average output power Note 1: launched into MMF. Supply current Icc max 260 mA (not stated in W). Data rate table unit printed as bps; values 1.0 / 10.3 / 10.7 treated as Gbps per context. SMSR row has no numeric limits in table.
provenance_datasheet_sections: LS-MM858G-S3C 8Gbps SFP+ Transceiver, Multi Mode, 300m Reach
general.suggestions: Clarify whether form_factor should include SFP+ when not in the schema enum. reach_km requires converting stated 300 m to km. Confirm whether post_fec_ber_target applies without explicit FEC (BER ≤1×10^-12 at 10312 Mbps).
